milestones.title: Port 80 Open for Business
milestones.when: shell: `curl --resolve host:80:IP http://host/` exit 0 (the vhost answers on port 80)

milestones.title: Certified Fresh
milestones.joke: A real cert, minted by machine.
milestones.when: shell: `certbot certonly` exit 0 (the client reports success; the CA log is not read)

milestones.title: Trust, Verified
milestones.joke: You checked the chain with your own eyes.
milestones.when: shell: `openssl s_client` or `curl https://...` against the demo site with `--cacert`/`-v`, exit 0
